description: This is a Java source file defining the 'Log' class, a helper utility for logging with various levels and forwarding logs to a chain of LogNode objects. It provides static methods for different log levels and manages a LogNode chain for output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging at various levels, mapping calls to a chain of LogNode objects and integrating with Android's native Log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode to which logs are sent.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs are forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with or without an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with or without an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, with or without an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with or without an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with or without an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert-level message, with or without an exception.
